_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The overflow menu popover opens and its compact controls work. The page's Notification API is fake: its permission starts "default", and requestPermission() denies it. "The trigger" is ".chat-overflow-menu-wrapper .btn-icon"; "the popover" is ".chat-overflow-popover". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Set localStorage "shelley-theme" to "system" and "shelley-notification-prefs" to '{"channels":{"favicon":{"enabled":true},"browser":{"enabled":true}}}', then reload by navigating to /c/{{SLUG}} again. 3. The trigger should be visible; click it. 4. The popover should be visible. Every choice is visible and the active icon is emphasized: the popover should have exactly 3 ".overflow-quick-control", elements whose text is exactly "Brevity", "Look" and "Notifications" should be visible, and it should have exactly 3 ".overflow-choice-options", exactly 7 ".overflow-choice-option" and exactly 3 ".overflow-choice-option.is-selected". 5. In data-testid "theme-cycle", the button whose accessible name contains "System" should have aria-pressed="true". 6. In data-testid "notification-toggle" ("the notification options"), the button named "Enable Notifications" should have aria-pressed="true". 7. Click the button named "Disable Notifications": it should get aria-pressed="true", and the "Enable Notifications" button should be enabled. 8. Click the "Enable Notifications" button. 9. The notification options' button named "Blocked by browser" should be disabled, and JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("shelley-notification-prefs") || "{}").channels?.browser?.enabled must be exactly false. 10. Click the theme-cycle button named "Light": the html element must not have the class "dark", and localStorage "shelley-theme" must be exactly "light". 11. Click the theme-cycle button named "Dark": the html element should have the class "dark", and localStorage "shelley-theme" must be exactly "dark". 12. The popover should still be visible.
